name: debugging
description: Debug observed failures via a disciplined six-phase loop: build a fast deterministic reproduction signal, reproduce, rank falsifiable hypotheses, instrument, fix with a regression test, then clean up and post-mortem.

medium.title: Preferred delivery medium
medium.description: Where the post-mortem view goes. auto (default): a local file; terminal: no page; file: a local file; artifact: a private Artifact; hosted is read as artifact. A team rendered-views file never publishes.
